title: Three Days to the Statement
subtitle: On 2 October 2026 a labelled composite CFO must sign a one-page note before the RBI MPC of 5–7 October votes: lock, wait, or disclose
description: HBS-style teaching case set three working days before the RBI Monetary Policy Committee meeting of 5–7 October 2026. The last voted policy is the August 2026 hold: repo 5.25%, SDF 5.00%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.50%, neutral stance, FY27 GDP 6.7%, FY27 CPI 5.0%. A Reuters poll (28 September) had 35 of 61 economists expecting +25 bps. Malabar Metals Limited, a labelled composite, must choose among locking floating lines, waiting, or disclosing a ₹1.78 crore sensitivity without changing conditional guidance.
sources: RBI. Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee, 3–5 August 2026. Unanimous hold: repo 5.25%, SDF 5.00%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.50%, neutral stance. FY27 real GDP 6.7% (Q1 7.0, Q2 6.4, Q3 6.5, Q4 6.8; Q1 FY28 7.3). FY27 CPI 5.0% (Q2 4.7, Q3 5.9, Q4 5.5).
RBI. Minutes of the MPC meeting, 3 to 5 August 2026, press release dated 19 August 2026. Chair: Governor Sanjay Malhotra.
Reuters (28 September 2026). Poll, fieldwork 18–28 September: 35 of 61 economists expected +25 bps to 5.50% at the 5–7 October meeting. August CPI cited at 4.82%.
Moneycontrol (25 September 2026). Poll of 13 economists and treasury heads: majority expected repo at 5.50%; FY27 growth forecast of 6.7% expected to be retained.
Economic Times / PTI (29–30 September 2026). Coverage of the Reuters poll and Nomura note looking for October and December steps toward 5.75%.
BW CFO World, Savi Khanna (10 March 2026). FICCI CFO Summit 2026, Hyderabad, theme Reimagining the Finance Role in the Age of AI. Aruna Singh, Vivek Chhabra, Rajneesh Jain as reported.
